I looked at the new section on `/pricing` at 1440 and 390. It renders correctly, and the page has no console errors beyond the two entries Playwright logged on load, which I didn't open.

- **1440:** "Questions about Custom" sits in the left column, and the three closed questions sit in the right column with a "+" on each. I opened the first one. It reads "Up to 10 pages, 5 templates, with type, layout and motion drawn for your brand alone, and site search built in at no extra fee. Starter is one page on a ready-made site." The left column is empty below the heading, as it is in the section above it.
- **390:** The heading stacks above the questions. Long questions wrap onto two lines without clipping, and the open answer is readable.

I didn't open the other two answers, so I haven't seen their text rendered.

A dev server is still running on port 3417 for this worktree, and I ran `npm ci` here because it had no `node_modules`. Nothing is committed.
